entries.title: j3w1.github.io site.css — the flagship web implementation
entries.notes: The :root block (lines 78–136) is the observed source of every role value. It will become a pinned consumer of this theme through a separate reviewed change; there is no live import.

entries.title: j3w1.github.io accessibility contract (contrast floor, reduced motion, focus)
entries.notes: Section 9 measured the palette and restricted --quiet and --inactive; this specification extends those rules (D-003).

entries.title: Xresources — the canonical sixteen-slot palette with the author's slot annotations
entries.notes: Exact values are preserved as color.primitive.ansi.*; the annotations seed the syntax roles. A 2020–21 X11 configuration proves nothing about current desktop installations.

entries.title: i3-gaps configuration — borders, gaps, bar and client colours
entries.notes: Source of the 1px borders, 14/−2 gaps and the focused/urgent colour classes. Window-manager geometry is reference metrics, not a cross-application rule.

entries.title: i3status colours — good, bad and degraded inside the same hue
entries.notes: A historical status semantic (#FFA2A7 / #A3676B / #C81A1A). Superseded for new work by D-001.

entries.title: dunst notification colours
entries.notes: Origin of the toast roles and the critical pair #DC282E / #F9FAF9 (4.58:1).

entries.title: gedit GtkSourceView scheme '1w3j' — a Solarized structure filled with reds
entries.notes: An early editor port by the owner. Not a supported download; values predate the token set.

entries.title: IntelliJ colour scheme '1w3j theme' (2020–21, Material Darker base, red chrome and console)
entries.notes: Only chrome, console, gutter and selection were recoloured; syntax stayed stock. Evidence that a JetBrains port has precedent, not a port.

entries.title: tmux status colours (pywal-cache variant)
entries.notes: Uses the non-canonical #0C0A09 / #D09899 variant; catalogued to explain why those values are not tokens.

entries.title: pywal-generated ramp (scripts/colors.sh)
entries.notes: The machine-generated predecessor of the hand-tuned Xresources palette. Not normative.
